verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents switching the same work between board, list, calendar, and timeline views. 'Visualize Epics on a Roadmap' and per-workflow-state story limits point to separate roadmap and kanban features, not a multi-view switcher. No calendar or list view is mentioned at all, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work
